params.name: Delimiter
params.reason: Groups matching keys under CommonPrefixes in the response.

params.name: EncodingType
params.reason: Controls how key values are encoded in the response.

params.name: KeyMarker
params.reason: Sets the key position after which listing begins.

params.name: MaxUploads
params.reason: Limits the number of uploads returned per page.

params.name: Prefix
params.reason: Returns uploads only for keys beginning with this prefix.

params.name: UploadIdMarker
params.reason: Sets the upload position after which listing begins.

reason: The parameters control response grouping or encoding, listing position and page size, or key-prefix filtering.
